svg.title: Starbase Enhanced Entity-Relationship Diagram
svg.desc: Conceptual and logical ER diagram showing core entities, associative tables with attributes (Material_Property, Project_Collaborator), and cardinality ratios.
svg.text: Enhanced logical entity model with associative tables, payload attributes, and cardinality constraints
• All many-to-many relationships (Material-Property, Material-Application, User-Project) are formally resolved via associative entities with payload attributes.
• Enforces 3NF: No repeating groups (1NF), no partial key dependencies (2NF), and zero transitive non-prime dependencies (3NF).
